title: Make Array Strictly Increasing
description: Find the minimum number of operations to make the array strictly increasing using elements from a second array.
pseudocode: 1. arr.sort(unique); 2. dp = { -1: 0 }; 3. for x in arr: 4.   new_dp = {}; 5.   for prev_val, cost in dp: 6.     if x > prev_val: new_dp[x] = min(new_dp[x], cost); 7.     for val in sorted_arr2: 8.       if val > prev_val: new_dp[val] = min(new_dp[val], cost + 1); 9.   dp = new_dp;

steps.note: Initialize DP with base case: previous value -1 and cost 0
